content: Build the workspace and run the robot arm demo
Building the ROS 2 workspace. Running `colcon build --symlink-install` in ros2_ws/...
[build] colcon build completed successfully. 1 package built: my_bot_py
Build succeeded. Now launching the robot arm publisher: `ros2 run my_bot_py robot_arm`
[ros] robot_arm_publisher node started. Publishing /joint_states at 20 Hz.

The robot arm demo is running. You should see sinusoidal motion in the MuJoCo tab. The arm is publishing joint states for 4 joints (base, shoulder, elbow, wrist) at 20 Hz.

To verify: `ros2 topic hz /joint_states` should show ~20 Hz.
Now send a position command to move the arm

First let me switch to the physics sim node which accepts position commands. Stopping the demo publisher and starting mujoco_sim...

```
ros2 run my_bot_py mujoco_sim
```

Now sending a position command:
```
ros2 topic pub --once /position_controller/commands std_msgs/msg/Float64MultiArray "{data: [0.5, 0.3, -0.8, 0.2]}"
```
[ros] mujoco_sim_node started. MuJoCo model loaded: 4 DOFs, 4 actuators. Listening on /position_controller/commands.
Position command sent. The arm should move to [0.5, 0.3, -0.8, 0.2] rad in the MuJoCo tab. The PD controller handles smooth interpolation.
